text: 韩国央行3年来首次加息！韩股走跌，估值隐忧与流动性压力陡升 韩国央行加入全球央行紧缩周期。韩国股市上半年录得历史级行情，但接下来估值隐忧与流动性压力走升。
text_en: Bank of Korea raises rates for first time in 3 years! Korean stocks fall, valuation concerns and liquidity pressures surge; BOK joins global central bank tightening cycle. Korean stock market saw historic rally in H1, but valuation concerns and liquidity pressures rise going forward.
